rationale: This is an incremental extension of the archived RND_CASH_AFTER_PAYABLES (same numerator, just also subtracting recch and invch), and the archive already shows that stripping working-capital components from the R&D cash wedge weakens rather than strengthens it (0.036/t=2.69 vs. 0.065/t=4.13 for the unadjusted wedge), so it is a cosmetic variant with a negative prior.

The expression is just the archived RND_INVENTORY_OBSOLESCENCE_TRAP with the margin-trend leg replaced by the receivables leg already used (with opposite sign) in RND_INVENTORY_BUILD_CASH_COLLECTION, and both parents produced the wrong-signed evidence for a negative expectation, so this is a low-content leg reshuffle rather than a new mechanism.

This is a direct clone of the archived GOODWILL_MOAT_ROLLOVER_ACCRUAL_MASK with the single substitution of xrd/sale for gdwl/at, and the R&D-intensity × margin-trend × accrual-wedge combination is already spanned by RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED and RND_MARGIN_INVENTORY_INFLATION.

It bolts an already-used margin-deterioration leg onto the archived GOODWILL_GROWTH_ACCRUAL_NONARTICULATION (level instead of delta goodwill), and that parent's evidence was internally contradictory (fmb −2.89 but ls_alpha +0.031/t=+2.52), so the negative expected sign is not supported for the non-directional ABS non-articulation leg being reused here.

Economically coherent and internally consistent, but it is essentially CAPITALIZED_INTAN_PRODUCTIVITY_TRAP with two operator swaps (intan level for delta, TS_RANK for TREND) — a cosmetic reparameterization of an archived signal rather than a substantively different mechanism.

The tax-accrual-magnitude × cash-flow-decay conditioning on R&D intensity is a genuinely different combination from the archived txp-level and txach-share variants and is directionally consistent, though the ABS(txach) leg is non-directional and risks proxying for scale or volatility rather than accounting opacity.
